content.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure - Task Force Members
content.note_on_declarations: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by the experts during the yearly call for declaration conducted every January covering the previous calendar year. Calls for declaration conducted during development period up to and including 2020.

expert.name: McMurray John J V
expert.summary: Direct personal payments from healthcare industry (speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member) and payments to employer/department for personal services or participation.
direct_personal_payments_companies: Global Clinical Trial Partners Ltd (GCTP) : Director
payments_to_employer_or_department: AbbVie: Glasgow University (employer) has been paid by Abbvie (who manufacture atrasentan) for time spent as Steering Committee member for the SONAR trial (using atrasentan) and meetings related to this trial; Abbvie has also paid travel and accommodation for some meetings. Payments made through a Consultancy with Glasgow University and the expert reports not receiving personal payments in relation to this trial/drug.
Alnylam: Glasgow University (employer) has been paid by Alnylam Pharmaceuticals for participation in a company advisory board about development of ALN-AGT01.
expert.additional_notes: Payments described include both direct personal payments and payments to the employer/department. The declaration covers various forms of industry relationships (speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator/committee membership).
